ark.title: Ark of the Cosmos
ark.description: This is a Terraria Calamity fanart I did back in the heyday of the mod. Good times. My idea was to create a dynamic, compositionally interesting artwork where the cosmic scissors reflected the player's expression as well as the foe he was facing. Unfortunately, I fell short on that aspect and settled for a piece that emphasizes color and texturing. Ultimately, a cool piece that came out of a failed attempt at something cooler.

bananasplit.title: Devourer of Gods
bananasplit.description: Another Terraria Calamity fanart I created. You can probably tell I was an avid fan. Anyways, this one holds a special place in my heart as possibly my highest effort fanart (excluding commissions). The composition came to me in a dream and the detailing was done in a fugue state. For my standards back then, this piece was a breakthrough and I remain proud of what I created.

black.title: Black
black.description: Every time artfight rolls around, I always tell myself that this is the year I finally lock in and produce 10 attacks minimum. Well, this is one of two attacks I finished in 2025. Though my quantity is low, I am quite proud of the quality of this work. It was the first time I truly felt I knew what I was doing with the lighting, and from the very start my vision was solidified and never wavered. Proud of the process on this one.

blackhole.title: Subsuming Vortex
blackhole.description: This was a funny little character design thing I tried for a class. Though the class didn't strictly require I create this, I enjoy drawing and spent a couple extra hours polishing a nice piece. This was definitely the fastest I've finished a character design work like this. Hopefully I find similar drive in the future.

cosmicdress.title: Cosmic Dress
cosmicdress.description: This is a piece I created for a prompt from my school club. I've always had a fascination with stars and the feelings they invoke in me. Furthermore, I've never been great with impressionist art or art that otherwise doesn't strictly reflect reality. WIth this piece, I really wanted to capture the feeling of stars rather than the way they really looked, and the warmth that the cosmos gives off in spite of being cold and endless.

dog.title: Devourer of Gods Commission
dog.description: This is my first real commissioned artwork. It also happens to be the highest effort single artwork I've ever produced, clocking in at just over 30 hours of total working time. I'm incredibly proud of myself for pulling through with this one, with no visual compromises whatsoever and adhering strongly to the vision. The cosmos and its impression on me is a recurring theme in my artworks, and this one is certainly no exception. Despite the main attraction being the combat in the foreground, every element in this work reflects some form of cosmic beauty and solitude.

green.title: Green (Speedpaint)
green.description: I've never been a huge fan of speedpaints. To me, paintings are something you stick with and improve. Sometimes you even return to them after months of honing your skill. However, this is one speedpaint I'm pretty happy with. I rarely manage to use my strokes efficiently and I think I've done that here.

hornet.title: Hornet
hornet.description: Fanart of Hornet from the indie game Silksong. I've never played the game before. I haven't even beaten Hollow Knight. They call me the larper.

kimiacity.title: Kimia's Hands-on Guide to Magic: Chapter 4 - City
kimiacity.description: Final page of Chapter 4. Kimia arrives at the city.

kimiaclouds.title: Kimia's Hands-on Guide to Magic: Chapter 4 - Clouds
kimiaclouds.description: Transition page for Chapter 4. Kimia begins her trek to Sylvaeris.

kimiacomets.title: Kimia's Hands-on Guide to Magic: Chapter 4 - Comets
kimiacomets.description: Kimia rests during her travels, observing a beautiful meteor shower.

kimiadescent.title: Kimia's Hands-on Guide to Magic: Chapter 4 - Descent
kimiadescent.description: Kimia descends a mountainside during her travels. Proud of this one.

kimialog.title: Kimia's Hands-on Guide to Magic: Chapter 4 - Log
kimialog.description: Kimia traverses the forests. This piece is actually a remaster of a much older piece, one of the first in a series of early Kimia works I was particularly proud of. The intention of those works from the very start was to eventually use them as comic pages in the future, so I'm super happy that I actually got to do that. Regardless, the painting holds up and I'm really proud of the result.

kimiaruins.title: Kimia's Hands-on Guide to Magic: Chapter 4 - Ruins
kimiaruins.description: Kimia crosses some ruins during her travels.

kimiasunrise.title: Kimia's Hands-on Guide to Magic: Chapter 4 - Sunrise
kimiasunrise.description: Kimia watches the sunrise groggily. This is another remaster of an older piece, and I think I did a good job of better capturing her personality and expression here.

kimiasword.title: Kimia's Hands-on Guide to Magic: Chapter 4 - Sword
kimiasword.description: Kimia travels the land, coming across a huge sword embedded in the ground.

pillars.title: Pillars
pillars.description: Another artwork in a series of early Kimia explorations. This was actually my favorite piece for quite a long time, for a variety of reasons. I've always loved sunset lighting, but the softness in this piece invokes a very nostalgic atmosphere I rarely succeed in capturing. The distant, subtle landscapes reflect a yearning to see the vastness of the wilderness I seldom cure. The pillars are probably the coolest part of the piece, but ironically, also the least interesting in terms of context. I just added them because they felt like they belonged.

providence.title: Providence
providence.description: Another fanart I produced for Terraria Calamity. The first one I've made of acceptable quality, and I'm still very pleased with the way it turned out. I think this piece marked a turning point for me in terms of how I viewed my art, and ever since posting it, I valued creating publishable works more and more. Don't know if that's a blessing or a curse just yet.

ruinedrobot.title: Ruined Robot
ruinedrobot.description: A piece I created for a club prompt. The robot also slots in nicely with the worldbuilding of Kimia: in the ancient days, robots were constructs of steel and wire, inefficient at routing magic and clumsy at handling fine instructions. As magic grew more and more advanced, engineers disposed of the mechanical shells they used to use as a crutch and opted for purely magically fueled options.

solyn.title: Solyn
solyn.description: Another Terraria Calamity fanart; this time from Wrath of the Gods specifically. Solyn is a character that accompanies you through a large part of the game and sacrifices herself at the end. Despite the writing being a little rushed, I found myself somewhat touched by her story and the imagery of her running through the garden with you one last time.

soma.title: Soma 1
soma.description: The second of the two artfight attacks I produced in 2025. This one features a vibed out fisheye perspective that doesn't translate all that well in the artwork. Regardless, I like how it looks and wouldn't change much about the artwork besides that darned right hand. It's so tiny. I should fix it.

twins.title: Twins
twins.description: This is a piece I created for my final project in English. Again, not something I strictly needed to draw, but I felt like it. It was featured in a video I spent dozens of hours animating and editing. I'm extremely proud of the video. I'm not as proud of this piece but it's alright enough.
